# Run C4: microGPT in native Fortress arrays, the synthesis

The merge of rounds two (`explorations/run-c/`) and three (`explorations/run-c3/`) decided in Phase 2 (`explorations/reviews/run-c2-vs-run-c3.md`, section H): C2's model with its rank-3 attention block, tuple-bound constants, varargs `flat`, index-generic operators, `transpose` beside `^T` and `diag`; C3's data side with the corpus object and `x DOT x` in the norms. The target program of the APL side quest.

- `src/MicroGptFlat.fss` (+ `.fsi`): the model only, 71 code lines; `run()` trains five Adam steps at batch 1 and prints the losses.
- `src/FlatArrays.fss` (+ `.fsi`): the array vocabulary: the elementwise algebra as operators generic in the index type, views (a matrix over a slice of the flat vector, a row, the per-head planes and back, a plane, the plane-wise transpose), the batched product, the row lift, keys, `flat`.
- `src/FlatData.fss` (+ `.fsi`): the loaders, the float parser, the corpus object (round three's).
- `src/MicroGptFlatCheck.fss`: the standard of success, 40 checks against `explorations/run-c/goldens`, an aggregate verdict, non-zero exit on any FAIL.
- `checks/threads1.txt`, `checks/threads4.txt`: the check outputs at pool sizes 1 and 4.
- `design.md`: what was merged from where and why, the line budget, the check, the cost, the map onto the Dyalog for the APL round.
- `tour.md`, `tour.html`, `tour/`: the guided tour, one row per Dyalog line (formula, Dyalog, Fortress set by Fortify, note), built by `tour/mktour.py`, which checks every snippet verbatim against the source; the page has round three's layout and follows the viewer's light or dark theme; `python3 tour/mktour.py --render` rebuilds the SVGs and both files.

## Run

```bash
source experiment/env.sh                         # JDK 25, FORTRESS_THREADS=1, -Xmx4g
cd explorations/run-c4/src
../../../bin/fortress MicroGptFlat.fss           # five steps
../../../bin/fortress MicroGptFlatCheck.fss > ../checks/threads1.txt 2>&1
FORTRESS_THREADS=4 ../../../bin/fortress MicroGptFlatCheck.fss > ../checks/threads4.txt 2>&1
```

The check imports the three components through the interpreter's source path, which starts at the working directory, and reads the corpus, the weights and the goldens by paths relative to `src/`, so run from `src/`. Bounded by construction: five steps, batches of at most four, no training.

1	(* MicroGptFlatCheck -- the standard of success for Run C4 (round three's check
     2	   with round two's four single-document checks added, 40 in all), one line per
     3	   check with the measured difference and PASS or FAIL, against the goldens of
     4	   Run C (explorations/run-c/goldens, extracted from
     5	   explorations/experiment/run-c-goldens/goldens.json), then an aggregate verdict; any FAIL
     6	   ends the run with a non-zero status.
     7	   Run from explorations/run-c4/src:  ../../../bin/fortress MicroGptFlatCheck.fss *)
     8	component MicroGptFlatCheck
     9	export Executable
    10	import MicroGptFlat.{...}
    11	import FlatArrays.{...}
    12	import FlatData.{...}
    13	import System.{...}
    14	
    15	goldensDir: String = "../../run-c/goldens"
    16	tolLoss: RR64 = 10.0^(-12)
    17	tolGrad: RR64 = 10.0^(-12)
    18	tolFd: RR64 = 10.0^(-8)
    19	
    20	passed: ZZ32 := 0
    21	failed: ZZ32 := 0
    22	report(name: String, diff: RR64, tol: RR64): () = do
    23	    ok = diff <= tol
    24	    if ok then passed += 1 else failed += 1 end
    25	    println name ": diff " diff " " (if ok then "PASS" else "FAIL" end)
    26	  end
    27	maxAbsDiff(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], b: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): RR64 = BIG MAX[\RR64\][i <- 0#|a|] |a[i] - b[i]|
    28	
    29	run(): () = do
    30	    println "MicroGptFlat checks (Run C4) | threads " (getProperty("fortress.threads", "?")) " | tolerances: loss " tolLoss " grad " tolGrad " fd " tolFd
    31	    wall0 = nanoTime()
    32	    p0 = loadParams("../../apl/reference/dzaima/w", matName, 9, nParams())
    33	    (* 0. the loaders against the goldens' P0 and corpus rows *)
    34	    report("loader: max |P - P0| over 4192", maxAbsDiff(p0, readVector(goldensDir "/P0.txt", 4192)), 0.0)
    35	    lines = readLines(goldensDir "/corpus_first16.txt")
    36	    corpusDiff = BIG MAX[\RR64\][d <- 0#16] do
    37	        nums = numbersOf(lines[d].beyond(' '))   (* the line is: name len t0 .. t16; nums[0] is len *)
    38	        (BIG MAX[\RR64\][j <- 0#17] |nums[1 + j] - (1.0 corpus.token(d, j))|) MAX |nums[0] - (1.0 corpus.length(d))|
    39	      end
    40	    report("corpus: max |row - golden| over documents 0..15", corpusDiff, 0.0)
    41	    (* 1. batch 1, five Adam steps from the committed weights on documents 0..4 *)
    42	    losses = readVector(goldensDir "/losses_batch1_5steps.txt", 5)
    43	    p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := p0
    44	    m: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := zeros(nParams())
    45	    v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := zeros(nParams())
    46	    g0 = zeros(nParams())
    47	    for s <- seq(0#5) do
    48	        b = keys(1, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => s)
    49	        t0 = nanoTime()
    50	        (l, g) = step(p, b)
    51	        if s = 0 then g0.assign(fn (i: ZZ32): RR64 => g[i]) end
    52	        (p, m, v) := adam(p, m, v, g, s + 1, learningRate(s))
    53	        if s = 0 then
    54	            report("step 0 batch 1: max |gradient - golden| over 4192", maxAbsDiff(g0, readVector(goldensDir "/grad_step0.txt", 4192)), tolGrad)
    55	            report("step 0 batch 1: max |P after Adam - golden| over 4192", maxAbsDiff(p, readVector(goldensDir "/P_after_adam.txt", 4192)), tolGrad)
    56	            zeroCount = SUM[\ZZ32\][i <- 0#nParams()] (if g0[i] = 0.0 then 1 else 0 end)
    57	            report("step 0 batch 1: zero gradient entries - 464", |1.0 zeroCount - 464.0|, 0.0)
    58	        end
    59	        report("batch 1 step " (s + 1) " loss " l " vs " losses[s] " (" ((nanoTime() - t0) DIV 1000000) " ms)", |l - losses[s]|, tolLoss)
    60	    end
    61	    (* 2. batch 4 on documents 0..3 from the initial weights *)
    62	    b4 = readVector(goldensDir "/batch4.txt", 9)      (* loss, 4 single losses, 4 lengths *)
    63	    t4 = nanoTime()
    64	    (l4, g4) = step(p0, keys(4, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => i))
    65	    report("batch 4 loss " l4 " vs golden " b4[0] " (" ((nanoTime() - t4) DIV 1000000) " ms)", |l4 - b4[0]|, tolLoss)
    66	    singles = zeros(4)
    67	    for d <- seq(0#4) do
    68	        (ld, gd) = step(p0, keys(1, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => d))
    69	        singles[d] := ld
    70	        report("batch 4: single-document loss " ld " vs golden " b4[1 + d] " (document " d ")", |ld - b4[1 + d]|, tolLoss)
    71	    end
    72	    weighted = (SUM[\RR64\][d <- 0#4] singles[d] (1.0 corpus.length(d))) / (SUM[\RR64\][d <- 0#4] 1.0 corpus.length(d))
    73	    report("batch 4 loss vs token-weighted mean of single-document losses " weighted, |l4 - weighted|, tolLoss)
    74	    (* 3. finite differences at the eleven golden indices, central, eps 1e-6 *)
    75	    eps = 10.0^(-6)
    76	    checkFd(tag: String, path: String, bk: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\], g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): () = do
    77	        fdRows = readLines(path)
    78	        worst: RR64 := 0.0
    79	        for r <- seq(0#|fdRows|) do
    80	            nums = numbersOf(fdRows[r])
    81	            idx = strToInt("" (|\ nums[0] /|))
    82	            pp = p0.copy(); pp[idx] := p0[idx] + eps
    83	            pm = p0.copy(); pm[idx] := p0[idx] - eps
    84	            (lp, gp) = step(pp, bk)
    85	            (lm, gm) = step(pm, bk)
    86	            fd = (lp - lm) / (2 eps)
    87	            diff = |fd - g[idx]|
    88	            worst := worst MAX diff
    89	            report(tag " P[" idx "] backprop " g[idx] " fd " fd " (golden fd " nums[2] ")", diff, tolFd)
    90	        end
    91	        report(tag " worst |fd - backprop|", worst, tolFd)
    92	      end
    93	    checkFd("fd doc 0", goldensDir "/fd_doc0.txt", keys(1, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => 0), g0)
    94	    checkFd("fd batch 4", goldensDir "/fd_batch4.txt", keys(4, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => i), g4)
    95	    println "total " ((nanoTime() - wall0) DIV 1000000000) " s"
    96	    println "VERDICT: " passed " PASS, " failed " FAIL of " (passed + failed) (if failed = 0 then " -- ALL PASS" else " -- FAILED" end)
    97	    if failed > 0 then fail("MicroGptFlatCheck: " failed " check(s) failed") end
    98	  end
    99	end

1	(* MicroGptFlat -- Karpathy's microGPT in native Fortress arrays, the data laid
     2	   out after Hsu's "Designing Your Data": one flat parameter vector whose nine
     3	   matrices are views, one integer corpus matrix, one pure step, Adam as
     4	   whole-vector expressions.  See explorations/run-c4/design.md. *)
     5	api MicroGptFlat
     6	import FlatData.{...}
     7

    19	step(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): (RR64, Array[\RR64,ZZ32\])

    21	(* Adam over flat state: (p, m, v) -> (p', m', v'); t counts from 1 *)
    22	adam(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], m: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], t: ZZ32, lr: RR64):
    23	    (Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], Array[\RR64,ZZ32\])
    24	learningRate(s: ZZ32): RR64
    25	
    26	end
    27	(* MicroGptFlat -- microGPT in native Fortress arrays, data designed after Hsu
    28	   (Run C4, the synthesis of rounds two and three: explorations/run-c4/design.md).
    29	   The model only: hyperparameters, the layout table, the four vector
    30	   functions, the step, Adam and the training loop, line for line against
    31	   explorations/apl/reference/hsu-flat/microgpt_concise.dyalog and the formulas
    32	   (the tour: explorations/run-c4/tour.md).  The array vocabulary is FlatArrays,
    33	   the loaders and the corpus FlatData.  Run from explorations/run-c4/src: the
    34	   paths are relative. *)
    35	component MicroGptFlat
    36	export MicroGptFlat
    37	export Executable
    38	import FlatArrays.{...}
    39	import FlatData.{...}
    40	import System.{...}
    41	
    42	(* --------------------------------------------------- hyperparameters ---- *)
    43	(nEmbd, blockSize, nHead, headDim, vocabSize, bosId) = (16, 16, 4, 4, 27, 26)
    44	(epsilon, lr0, beta1, beta2, epsilon_A, nSteps) = (10.0^(-5), 0.01, 0.85, 0.99, 10.0^(-8), 1000)
    45	(corpusPath, weightsDir) = ("../../apl/reference/dzaima/docs.txt", "../../apl/reference/dzaima/w")
    46	
    47	(* ^T on a matrix and on every plane of a rank-3 array, declared here and not
    48	   in the vocabulary because an API cannot declare a postfix operator (row 133) *)
    49	opr (m: Matrix[\RR64,r,c\])^T[\nat r, nat c\]: Matrix[\RR64,c,r\] = transpose(m)
    50	opr (t: Array3[\RR64,0,a,0,b,0,c\])^T[\nat a, nat b, nat c\]: Array3[\RR64,0,a,0,c,0,b\] = transpose(t)
    51	
    52	(* -------------------------------------- rmsn, sm and their backward ------ *)
    53	rmsn(x: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = x / SQRT (epsilon + (x DOT x) / |x|)
    54	sm(z: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = do e = exp(z - (BIG MAX z)); e / (SUM e) end
    55	mask: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = mat(blockSize, blockSize, fn (i: ZZ32, j: ZZ32): RR64 => if j > i then -(10.0^10) else 0.0 end)
    56	rmsn_b(dy: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], x: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = do
    57	    r = SQRT (epsilon + (x DOT x) / |x|); y = x / r
    58	    (dy - y ((y DOT dy) / |y|)) / r
    59	  end
    60	sm_b(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], dy: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = p × (dy - (p DOT dy))
    61	
    62	(* ------------------------------- tactic 2/8: one vector, nine views ------ *)
    63	matName(i: ZZ32): String =
    64	    if i = 0 then "wte" elif i = 1 then "wpe" elif i = 2 then "lm_head" elif i = 3 then "attn_wq" elif i = 4 then "attn_wk"
    65	    elif i = 5 then "attn_wv" elif i = 6 then "attn_wo" elif i = 7 then "mlp_fc1" else "mlp_fc2" end
    66	matShape(i: ZZ32): (ZZ32, ZZ32) =
    67	    if (i = 0) OR (i = 2) then (vocabSize, nEmbd) elif i = 7 then (4 nEmbd, nEmbd) elif i = 8 then (nEmbd, 4 nEmbd) else (nEmbd, nEmbd) end
    68	matCount(i: ZZ32): ZZ32 = do (r, c) = matShape(i); r c end
    69	matOffset(i: ZZ32): ZZ32 = SUM[\ZZ32\][j <- 0#i] matCount(j)
    70	nParams(): ZZ32 = matOffset(9)
    71	view(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], i: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = do (r, c) = matShape(i); view(p, matOffset(i), r, c) end
    72	
    73	(* -------------------- tactic 3/5: the corpus as one padded integer matrix - *)
    74	corpus: Corpus = loadCorpus(corpusPath, blockSize, bosId)
    75	
    76	(* ------------------------- the step: keys -> (loss, flat gradient). Pure. -- *)
    77	step(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): (RR64, Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]) = do
    78	    ids = corpus.tokens(b, 0); tg = corpus.tokens(b, 1); vm = corpus.valid(b); nv = SUM vm; pos = corpus.positions(b)
    79	    (wte, wpe, lm, wq, wk, wv, wo, f1, f2) = (view(p, 0), view(p, 1), view(p, 2), view(p, 3), view(p, 4), view(p, 5), view(p, 6), view(p, 7), view(p, 8))
    80	    h(m: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = heads(m, blockSize, nHead, headDim)
    81	    u(t: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = unheads(t, nHead)
    82	    (* -- forward, all (doc, pos) rows at once -- *)
    83	    x = gather(wte, ids) + gather(wpe, pos); xp = rows(rmsn, x); x1 = rows(rmsn, xp)
    84	    (q, k, v) = (x1 wq^T, x1 wk^T, x1 wv^T); (qh, kh, vh) = (h(q), h(k), h(v))
    85	    a = rows(sm, mask + (qh kh^T) / SQRT (1.0 headDim)); hc = u(a vh)
    86	    x2 = xp + hc wo^T; x3 = rows(rmsn, x2); m0 = x3 f1^T; mr = 0.0 MAX m0; x4 = x2 + mr f2^T
    87	    pr = rows(sm, x4 lm^T); loss = -(vm DOT log(pick(pr, tg))) / nv
    88	    (* -- backward, one line under each forward line, bottom-up -- *)
    89	    dL = diag(vm / nv) (pr - onehot(tg, vocabSize)); gLM = dL^T x4; dX4 = dL lm
    90	    gF2 = dX4^T mr; dM0 = (dX4 f2) × (m0 > 0.0); gF1 = dM0^T x3; dX3 = dM0 f1
    91	    dX2 = dX4 + rows(rmsn_b, dX3, x2); gWO = dX2^T hc; dh = h(dX2 wo)
    92	    dVh = a^T dh; dS = rows(sm_b, a, dh vh^T) / SQRT (1.0 headDim)
    93	    dQh = dS kh; dKh = dS^T qh; (dQ, dK, dV) = (u(dQh), u(dKh), u(dVh))
    94	    (gWQ, gWK, gWV) = (dQ^T x1, dK^T x1, dV^T x1); dX1 = dQ wq + dK wk + dV wv
    95	    dXp = dX2 + rows(rmsn_b, dX1, xp); dX = rows(rmsn_b, dXp, x)
    96	    gWTE = transpose(onehot(ids, vocabSize)) dX; gWPE = transpose(onehot(pos, blockSize)) dX
    97	    (loss, flat(gWTE, gWPE, gLM, gWQ, gWK, gWV, gWO, gF1, gF2))
    98	  end
    99	
   100	(* --------------------- Adam: three whole-vector expressions over p, m, v -- *)
   101	adam(p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], m: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], t: ZZ32, lr: RR64):
   102	    (Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]) = do
   103	    m' = beta1 m + (1 - beta1) g
   104	    v' = beta2 v + (1 - beta2) (g × g)
   105	    p' = p - (lr (m' / (1 - beta1^t))) / (SQRT (v' / (1 - beta2^t)) + epsilon_A)
   106	    (p', m', v')
   107	  end
   108	learningRate(s: ZZ32): RR64 = lr0 (1 - (1.0 s) / nSteps)
   109	
   110	(* --------------------------------------------------- training ----------- *)
   111	run(): () = do
   112	    println "microgpt flat | params " nParams() " | corpus " corpus.size() " x " (blockSize + 1) " | batch 1, 5 steps"
   113	    bsz = 1
   114	    p: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := loadParams(weightsDir, matName, 9, nParams())
   115	    m: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := zeros(nParams())
   116	    v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := zeros(nParams())
   117	    for s <- seq(0#5) do
   118	        t0 = nanoTime()
   119	        (l, g) = step(p, keys(bsz, fn (i: ZZ32): ZZ32 => (s bsz + i) MOD corpus.size()))
   120	        (p, m, v) := adam(p, m, v, g, s + 1, learningRate(s))
   121	        println "step " (s + 1) " loss " l "  (" ((nanoTime() - t0) DIV 1000000) " ms)"
   122	    end
   123	  end
   124	end

1	(* FlatData -- the loaders and the corpus for MicroGptFlat (Run C4). *)
     2	api FlatData
     3	import FlatArrays.{...}
     4	
     5	parseFloat(s: String): RR64
     6	numbersOf(line: String): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]
     7	readLines(path: String): Array[\String,ZZ32\]
     8	readVector(path: String, n: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]
     9	loadParams(dir: String, name: ZZ32 -> String, count: ZZ32, total: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]
    10	
    11	(* the corpus: one padded integer matrix (documents x block+1) and a length per document *)
    12	object Corpus(tokm: Array[\ZZ32,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], len: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\], blk: ZZ32)
    13	    size(): ZZ32
    14	    length(d: ZZ32): ZZ32
    15	    token(d: ZZ32, j: ZZ32): ZZ32
    16	    tokens(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\], off: ZZ32): Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]
    17	    positions(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]
    18	    valid(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]

    22	(* FlatData -- the loaders and the corpus for MicroGptFlat (Run C4).
    23	   The weights are nine text files, one matrix row per line, read straight
    24	   into one flat vector in layout order; the corpus is one padded integer
    25	   matrix (documents x block+1) with a length per document (Hsu's tactics
    26	   3 and 5). The float parser is here because the library's strToFloat
    27	   mis-parses a sign and overflows on a 17-digit mantissa (ledger row 140)
    28	   and String.split is not a tokenizer (row 141). *)
    29	component FlatData
    30	export FlatData
    31	import FlatArrays.{...}
    32	import File.{...}
    33	
    34	(* decimal digits, optional '.', optional e/E exponent; leading '-' or '¯' *)
    35	parseFloat(s: String): RR64 = do
    36	    neg = (s[0] = '-') OR (s[0] = '¯')
    37	    m: RR64 := 0.0
    38	    scale: ZZ32 := 0
    39	    ex: ZZ32 := 0
    40	    i: ZZ32 := if neg then 1 else 0 end
    41	    seenPoint: Boolean := false
    42	    n = |s|
    43	    while (i < n) AND: ((s[i] =/= 'e') AND (s[i] =/= 'E')) do
    44	        c = s[i]
    45	        if c = '.' then seenPoint := true
    46	        else
    47	            m := 10.0 m + (c.codePoint - '0'.codePoint)
    48	            if seenPoint then scale += 1 end
    49	        end
    50	        i += 1
    51	    end
    52	    if i < n then
    53	        eneg = (s[i+1] = '-') OR (s[i+1] = '¯')
    54	        j = if eneg OR (s[i+1] = '+') then i + 2 else i + 1 end
    55	        ex := strToInt(s[j # (n - j)])
    56	        if eneg then ex := -ex end
    57	    end
    58	    e10 = ex - scale
    59	    r = if e10 >= 0 then m (10.0^e10)
    60	        elif e10 >= -22 then m / (10.0^(-e10))
    61	        else (m / (10.0^22)) / (10.0^(-e10 - 22)) end
    62	    if neg then -r else r end
    63	  end
    64	
    65	(* the space-separated numbers of a line, into out[off..]; returns how many *)
    66	parseRow[\nat s\](line: String, out: Vector[\RR64,s\], off: ZZ32): ZZ32 = do
    67	    n = |line|
    68	    i: ZZ32 := 0
    69	    k: ZZ32 := 0
    70	    while i < n do
    71	        if line[i] = ' ' then i += 1
    72	        else
    73	            j: ZZ32 := i
    74	            while (j < n) AND: (line[j] =/= ' ') do j += 1 end
    75	            out[off + k] := parseFloat(line[i # (j - i)])
    76	            k += 1
    77	            i := j
    78	        end
    79	    end
    80	    k
    81	  end
    82	(* the numbers of a line as a vector (two scans: count, then fill) *)
    83	numbersOf(line: String): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = do
    84	    cnt = parseRow(line, zeros(|line|), 0)
    85	    out = zeros(cnt)
    86	    parseRow(line, out, 0)
    87	    out
    88	  end
    89	(* the lines of a file, up to the first empty one *)
    90	readLines(path: String): Array[\String,ZZ32\] = do
    91	    f = FileReadStream(path)
    92	    cnt: ZZ32 := 0
    93	    line: String := f.readLine()
    94	    while |line| > 0 do cnt += 1; line := f.readLine() end
    95	    f.close()
    96	    g = FileReadStream(path)
    97	    out = array[\String\](cnt).fill("")
    98	    for i <- seq(0#cnt) do out[i] := g.readLine() end
    99	    g.close()
   100	    out
   101	  end
   102	(* one number per line *)
   103	readVector(path: String, n: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = do
   104	    f = FileReadStream(path)
   105	    v = zeros(n)
   106	    for i <- seq(0#n) do v[i] := parseFloat(f.readLine()) end
   107	    f.close()
   108	    v
   109	  end
   110	
   111	(* the weights: files name(0) .. name(count-1) under dir, every line's numbers
   112	   appended in order into one vector of `total` values -- the layout is the
   113	   caller's table, the loader only concatenates *)
   114	loadParams(dir: String, name: ZZ32 -> String, count: ZZ32, total: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = do
   115	    p = zeros(total)
   116	    off: ZZ32 := 0
   117	    for i <- seq(0#count) do
   118	        for line <- seq(readLines(dir "/" name(i) ".txt")) do off += parseRow(line, p, off) end
   119	    end
   120	    if off =/= total then fail("loaded " off " numbers, the layout has " total) end
   121	    p
   122	  end
   123	
   124	(* the corpus: one document per line, interned a..z; the token matrix has
   125	   width block+1, BOS before and after each document and in every unused
   126	   slot, and a length per document (its characters plus the leading BOS) *)
   127	object Corpus(tokm: Array[\ZZ32,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], len: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\], blk: ZZ32)
   128	    size(): ZZ32 = |len|
   129	    length(d: ZZ32): ZZ32 = len[d]
   130	    token(d: ZZ32, j: ZZ32): ZZ32 = tokm[d, j]
   131	    (* the keys of a batch b of documents, one row per (document, position):
   132	       the tokens at position + off, the positions, and the 0/1 validity mask *)
   133	    tokens(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\], off: ZZ32): Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\] =
   134	        keys(|b| blk, fn (r: ZZ32): ZZ32 => tokm[b[r DIV blk], (r MOD blk) + off])
   135	    positions(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\] =
   136	        keys(|b| blk, fn (r: ZZ32): ZZ32 => r MOD blk)
   137	    valid(b: Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] =
   138	        vec(|b| blk, fn (r: ZZ32): RR64 => if (r MOD blk) < len[b[r DIV blk]] then 1.0 else 0.0 end)
   139	end
   140	loadCorpus(path: String, blk: ZZ32, bos: ZZ32): Corpus = do
   141	    names = readLines(path)
   142	    tokm = array[\ZZ32\](|names|, blk + 1).fill(bos)
   143	    for d <- seq(0#|names|), j <- seq(0#|names[d]|) do tokm[d, 1 + j] := names[d][j].codePoint - 'a'.codePoint end
   144	    Corpus(tokm, keys(|names|, fn (d: ZZ32): ZZ32 => 1 + |names[d]|), blk)
   145	  end
   146	end

1	(* FlatArrays -- the array vocabulary of Run C4: what the shipped
     2	   Vector/Matrix algebra lacks, declared once in the library's own style over
     3	   the library's own arrays.  Round two's vocabulary (explorations/run-c/src)
     4	   less the block, ravel, vector-gather and validity pieces that the corpus
     5	   object of FlatData makes unnecessary; the inventory it was built against
     6	   is round three's survey (explorations/run-c3/survey.md).  Views take their
     7	   shapes at run time through the library's own reflect idiom
     8	   (FortressLibrary.fss:1922-1934). *)
     9	component FlatArrays
    10	export FlatArrays
    11	import NatReflect.{...}
    12	
    13	(* ------------------------------------------------------- constructors ---- *)
    14	vec(n: ZZ32, f: ZZ32 -> RR64): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = array[\RR64\](n).fill(f)
    15	zeros(n: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = array[\RR64\](n).fill(0.0)
    16	keys(n: ZZ32, f: ZZ32 -> ZZ32): Array[\ZZ32,ZZ32\] = array[\ZZ32\](n).fill(f)
    17	mat(r: ZZ32, c: ZZ32, f: (ZZ32,ZZ32) -> RR64): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = array[\RR64\](r,c).fill(f)
    18	
    19	(* ------------------------------------------- the elementwise algebra ----- *)
    20	(* One declaration per operator, generic in the index type I, so a vector
    21	   (I = ZZ32), a matrix ((ZZ32,ZZ32)) and a rank-3 array share it.  A scalar
    22	   times an array is the library's juxtaposition and is not redeclared;
    23	   + and - between two arrays of one shape, and + - MIN MAX between an array
    24	   and a scalar, are the library's. *)
    25	opr ×[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\], b: Array[\RR64,I\]): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (i: I, e: RR64): RR64 => e b[i])
    26	opr /[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\], b: Array[\RR64,I\]): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (i: I, e: RR64): RR64 => e / b[i])
    27	opr /[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\], s: RR64): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.map[\RR64\](fn (e: RR64): RR64 => e / s)
    28	(* a comparison on an array is a 0/1 array *)
    29	opr >[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\], s: RR64): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.map[\RR64\](fn (e: RR64): RR64 => if e > s then 1.0 else 0.0 end)
    30	opr SQRT[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\]): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.map[\RR64\](fn (e: RR64): RR64 => SQRT e)
    31	exp[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\]): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.map[\RR64\](fn (e: RR64): RR64 => exp(e))
    32	log[\I\](a: Array[\RR64,I\]): Array[\RR64,I\] = a.map[\RR64\](fn (e: RR64): RR64 => log(e))
    33	(* diag(v) m scales the rows of m: the Dyalog's v ×⍤0 1 m.  A diagonal is a
    34	   read-only Matrix view; the library's product forwards to its mul, which
    35	   scales the rows without forming the matrix. *)
    36	object Diag[\nat s\](d: Vector[\RR64,s\]) extends Matrix[\RR64,s,s\]
    37	    get(ij: (ZZ32,ZZ32)): RR64 = do (i, j) = ij; if i = j then d[i] else 0.0 end end

abstract fill(v:E):ImmutableArray[\E,I\]
    abstract copy():ImmutableArray[\E,I\]
    abstract replica[\U\]():ImmutableArray[\U,I\]

    (** Thaw array (return mutable copy). **)
    abstract thaw():Array[\E,I\]
end

trait Array[\E,I\] extends { ReadableArray[\E,I\], MutableIndexed[\E,I\] }
    abstract put(i:I, e:E): ()
    opr[i:I]:=(v:E):()

    opr[r:Range[\I\]]:=(a:Indexed[\E,I\]):()

    abstract opr[r:Range[\I\]] : Array[\E,I\]
    abstract opr[_:TrivialOpenRange] : Array[\E,I\]
    abstract ivmap[\R\](f:(I,E)->R): Array[\R, I\]
    abstract map[\R\](f:E->R): Array[\R, I\]
    abstract shift(newOrigin:I):Array[\E,I\]
    abstract fill(f:I->E):Array[\E,I\]
    abstract fill(v:E):Array[\E,I\]
    abstract assign(f:I->E):Array[\E,I\]
    abstract copy():Array[\E,I\]
    abstract replica[\U\]():Array[\U,I\]

    (** Freeze array (return mutable copy). **)
    abstract freeze(): ImmutableArray[\E,I\]
end

(** Factory for arrays that returns an empty 0-indexed array of a given
    run-time-determined size. **)
array[\E\](x:ZZ32):Array[\E,ZZ32\]
array[\E\](x:ZZ32,y:ZZ32):Array[\E,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]
array[\E\](x:ZZ32,y:ZZ32,z:ZZ32):Array[\E,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\]

(** Factory for immutable arrays that returns an empty 0-indexed array
    of a given run-time-determined size. **)
immutableArray[\E\](x:ZZ32):ImmutableArray[\E,ZZ32\]
immutableArray[\E\](x:ZZ32,y:ZZ32):ImmutableArray[\E,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]
immutableArray[\E\](x:ZZ32,y:ZZ32,z:ZZ32):ImmutableArray[\E,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\]

primitiveArray[\E\](x:ZZ32):Array[\E,ZZ32\]

primitiveImmutableArray[\E\](x:ZZ32):ImmutableArray[\E,ZZ32\]

(** NOTE: %StandardImmutableArrayType% is a parent of
    %StandardMutableArrayType%.  It therefore does not extend
    %ImmutableArray% as you might expect.  Other types that extend
    it should also extend %ImmutableArray% explicitly. **)
trait StandardImmutableArrayType[\T extends StandardImmutableArrayType[\T,E,I\],E,I\]
        extends { ReadableArray[\E,I\] }
    fill(f:I->E):T
    fill(v:E):T
    abstract copy():T
end


trait StandardMutableArrayType[\T extends StandardMutableArrayType[\T,E,I\],E,I\]
        extends { StandardImmutableArrayType[\T,E,I\], Array[\E,I\] }
    assign(v:T):T
    assign(f:I->E):T
end

(** Canonical partitioning of a positive number %x% into two pieces.  If
   %(a,b) = partition(n)%
   and $n > 0$ then $0 < a <= b$, $n = a + b$.
   As it turns out we choose $a$ to be the largest power of $2 < n$.
*)
partition(x:ZZ32):(ZZ32,ZZ32)

(** A %ReadableArray1[\T,b0,s0\]% is
    an arbitrary 1-dimensional array whose %s0% elements are of
    type %T%, and whose lowest index is %b0%.

    The natural order of all generators is from %b0% to
    %b0+s0-1%. **)
trait ReadableArray1[\T, nat b0, nat s0\]
        extends { Indexed1[\s0\], Rank1, ReadableArray[\T,ZZ32\] }
        comprises { ImmutableArray1[\T,b0,s0\], Array1[\T,b0,s0\] }
    getter size():ZZ32
    getter bounds():CompactFullRange[\ZZ32\]

type %T%, and whose lowest index is %b0%. **)
trait Array1[\T, nat b0, nat s0\]
    extends { ReadableArray1[\T,b0,s0\],
              StandardMutableArrayType[\Array1[\T,b0,s0\],T,ZZ32\] }
    excludes {Number, String}

    getter mutability():String

    shift(o:ZZ32): Array[\T,ZZ32\]

    opr[r: Range[\ZZ32\]] : Array[\T,ZZ32\]
    opr[_:OpenRange[\ZZ32\]] : Array1[\T,0,s0\]
    opr[_:TrivialOpenRange] : Array1[\T,0,s0\]

    subarray[\nat b, nat s, nat o\](m:ZZ32):Array1[\T, b, s\]

    replica[\U\]():Array1[\U,b0,s0\]

    copy():Array1[\T,b0,s0\]
    freeze():ImmutableArray1[\T,b0,s0\]
    map[\R\](f:T->R): Array1[\R,b0,s0\]
    ivmap[\R\](f:(ZZ32,T)->R): Array1[\R,b0,s0\]
end

trait AnyVector end

trait Vector[\T extends Number, nat s0\]
